nodes.text: The objective, the audience, the big idea, the calendar, the budget, and the dashboard we will check every week.
Mei Lin, Head of Marketing  ·  12 December 2026
a year, four campaigns, one Friday
What we owe the business in 2027
Marketing-sourced, first touch, measured in the CRM.
Up from 140; the free tier is the largest new source.
In our category, measured quarterly by the analyst survey.
Same money, reweighted toward the channels that worked.
One place for the whole team
one line per person, or it is not a message
One idea, four campaigns, twelve months and one budget. Everything after this page is how the money gets spent.
argue with the calendar, not the idea
The big idea: show the afternoon a team gets back. Not the features, the Friday.
the whole campaign in one breath
Launch film on 14 January, a customer story a week after
Published 5 May; the briefings run through June
Twenty partners, one co-written story a week
Four hundred people on 12 November; the 2028 plan from the stage
A bar spans the months a campaign is live; the figure under it is its share of the $1.9M.
Spend by channel, with expected return
Content and partners carry the plan; events are the bet; paid stays capped.
Events, the bet of the year
content earns it, events bet it
$9M for the year, so $750K a month. First touch, in the CRM, nothing counted by hand.
200 a month. The free tier is the largest new source and gets its own line.
38% by Q4. The analyst survey each quarter, mentions each month in between.
$790 or under. A channel above $1,200 for two months in a row loses its money.
miss twice and the money moves
One dashboard, four numbers, checked every Monday at nine. If a channel misses two months, we move its money.
